dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: Hi, do you have a minute? You look worried.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. I would like to ask for a day off next Friday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A little. I must go to my cousin's wedding in another city.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: I see. Who can cover your work that day?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My colleague can replace me, and I will prepare everything in advance.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: That is helpful. Have you asked her already?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Not yet. I wanted to speak with you first, as a favor.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: I understand. You may take the day, but finish the report before you leave.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Of course, thank you for being so understanding.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you very much. I will bring you some cake.
